description: This Java class 'ScaleImage' provides methods to scale product images into multiple predefined sizes (small, medium, large, detail). It reads configuration from XML, processes images, creates scaled versions, saves them to specified directories, and generates URLs for these images. It handles different view types ('Main' and 'additional') and manages file system operations including directory creation and cleanup.

classes.name: ScaleImage
classes.description: Provides static methods to scale product images into multiple sizes, handle image processing, file management, and URL generation.

methods.name: scaleImageInAllSize
methods.description: Scales the original image into small, medium, large, and detail sizes based on configuration, saves scaled images, and returns their URLs.

methods.name: scaleImageManageInAllSize
methods.description: Similar to scaleImageInAllSize but allows specifying specific image types and handles additional view types.

methods.name: scaleImageManageInAllSize
methods.description: Overloaded method that scales images into specified sizes, managing directories and URLs, for given view and image type.
